cases.summary: User opens transaction historic from top icons
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Select activity historic from top icons.
cases.expected: List of transaction historic is shown.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-001; Transaction historic — top icons

cases.summary: User sees only transaction types allowed by credentials
cases.preconditions: Two profiles with different authorised transaction types
cases.expected: User according to their credentials will not have access to all type of Transaction. Types listed: Customer registration, Airtime & Bundle sales, Customer Services.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-002, REQ-005; Type of transactions

cases.summary: Only current-day transactions from midnight to midnight
cases.preconditions: A same-day transaction and a previous-day transaction
cases.expected: User views all transactions realised during the day. Historic is maintained for the current day only, starting and ending at midnight.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-007; current day only

cases.summary: Historic is ordered temporally and can be filtered by type
cases.expected: Ordered temporally. User can filter through the type of transactions.
Shows Transaction ID, date and time, certification status (certified, on-going, rejected).

cases.preconditions: A same-day airtime or bundle sale
cases.expected: Shows date and time, customer MSISDN, airtime top-up/bundle purchase, transaction cost. Commission earned is not asserted: comment 2026-09-17 says commission amount is removed.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-010; Listing — Airtime & bundle sales

cases.expected: Shows products & amount reloaded, time and date, cost, touchpoint name and MSISDN who received the reload.

Shows transaction volume at the top, customer MSISDN except client registration, type, date and time, Transaction ID, colour-coded certification for registration (Certified / On-going / Reject), Need Help at the bottom.

cases.summary: Rejected registration shows reason and Upgrade Customer File
cases.expected: Rejection reason is shown. Upgrade customer file button redirects to the flow.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-013; Reject — reason and upgrade button

cases.summary: Upgrade from historic is only for rejected files and pre-fills the number
cases.preconditions: Rejected customer file in historic; agent authorised for upgrade
cases.expected: User is redirected to AA-6.3 Check and Upgrade Customer Status. Only rejected files. Customer number is already populated and certification status is shown with required missing details.

cases.summary: Commission display vs BO disable, superseded by comment
cases.preconditions: Admin commission scheme on or off
cases.expected: Description says commission per transaction and total at the bottom, hidden if disabled from BO. Comment 2026-09-17: commission amount is removed. Assert commission is not shown.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-015; Commissions + comment commission amount is removed

cases.summary: Performance card at the top of historic
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: A performance card is at the top showing balance at beginning of day, generated revenue (sum of transaction costs, commissions not included), and balance end of day.

cases.summary: KPI arrows vs yesterday or target
cases.input: 1. Observe arrows on the historic performance card.
cases.expected: Registration/Certification/Active Agents/Airtime sales/Reload/POS out of stock vs yesterday; Gross Add vs target. Greater: up green. Lower: down red. Equal: horizontal orange.

cases.summary: Preconditions row says notifications; normal course says activity historic
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open activity historic from top icons, not notifications.
cases.expected: Normal Course is used: activity historic from top icons. The Preconditions line that says notifications is treated as a copy error, not a second entry point.
cases.traceability: SAA-915; REQ-001; Normal Course vs Preconditions
